name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have hl := UpdateStatesLength hu
  have hl' := InitStatesLength hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit hl'
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu)
    (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  simp [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu, updatedStates]
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate hl (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
  · simp_all only [List.unzip_zip]
    intro x hx hx'
    simpa [InitStatesNotDefined hi x hx'] using UpdateStatesDefined hu x hx

name: Lambda.denote_suffix_irrel
proof:
theorem denote_suffix_irrel
    {e : LExpr T.mono} {τ : LMonoTy}
    {Δ₁ : List LMonoTy} {Δ₂ Δ₂' : List LMonoTy}
    (h_lc : LExpr.lcAt Δ₁.length e = true)
    (h₁ : LExpr.HasTypeA (Δ₁ ++ Δ₂) e τ)
    (h₂ : LExpr.HasTypeA (Δ₁ ++ Δ₂') e τ)
    (bv₁ : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ₁)
    (bv₂ : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ₂)
    (bv₂' : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ₂')
    : LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt (HList.append bv₁ bv₂) e τ h₁ =
      LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt (HList.append bv₁ bv₂') e τ h₂ := by
  induction e generalizing Δ₁ τ with
  | const => rfl
  | op _ _ ty | fvar _ _ ty =>
    cases ty with
    | none => exact absurd (LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h₁) (by simp [LExpr.typeCheck])
    | some => rfl
  | bvar m i =>
    simp [LExpr.lcAt] at h_lc
    have hp : Δ₁[i]? = some τ := by
      have h := HasTypeA.bvar_inv h₁
      rwa [List.getElem?_append_left (by omega)] at h
    exact (HList.get_append_left bv₁ bv₂ i (HasTypeA.bvar_inv h₁) hp).trans
      (HList.get_append_left bv₁ bv₂' i (HasTypeA.bvar_inv h₂) hp).symm
  | app _ fn arg ih_fn ih_arg =>
    obtain ⟨aty, hf, ha⟩ := HasTypeA.app_inv h₁
    obtain ⟨aty', hf', ha'⟩ := HasTypeA.app_inv h₂
    simp only [LExpr.lcAt, Bool.and_eq_true] at h_lc
    have ht := typeCheck_of_lcAt_aux (Δ := Δ₁ ++ Δ₂) (Δ' := Δ₁ ++ Δ₂') h_lc.2
      (fun i hi => by rw [List.getElem?_append_left hi, List.getElem?_append_left hi])
    rw [LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck ha, LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck ha'] at ht
    cases Option.some.inj ht
    rw [denote_app _ hf ha h₁, denote_app _ hf' ha' h₂,
      ih_fn h_lc.1 hf hf' bv₁, ih_arg h_lc.2 ha ha' bv₁]
  | ite _ c t e ih_c ih_t ih_e =>
    obtain ⟨hc, ht, he⟩ := HasTypeA.ite_inv h₁
    obtain ⟨hc', ht', he'⟩ := HasTypeA.ite_inv h₂
    simp only [LExpr.lcAt, Bool.and_eq_true] at h_lc
    rw [denote_ite _ hc ht he, denote_ite _ hc' ht' he',
      ih_c h_lc.1.1 hc hc' bv₁, ih_t h_lc.1.2 ht ht' bv₁, ih_e h_lc.2 he he' bv₁]
  | eq _ e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
    obtain ⟨ty, hb, ha, hc⟩ := HasTypeA.eq_inv h₁
    obtain ⟨ty', hb', ha', hc'⟩ := HasTypeA.eq_inv h₂
    subst hb; cases hb'
    simp only [LExpr.lcAt, Bool.and_eq_true] at h_lc
    have ht := typeCheck_of_lcAt_aux (Δ := Δ₁ ++ Δ₂) (Δ' := Δ₁ ++ Δ₂') h_lc.1
      (fun i hi => by rw [List.getElem?_append_left hi, List.getElem?_append_left hi])
    rw [LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck ha, LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck ha'] at ht
    cases Option.some.inj ht
    have hleft := ih1 h_lc.1 ha ha' bv₁
    have hright := ih2 h_lc.2 hc hc' bv₁
    by_cases hv : LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt (HList.append bv₁ bv₂) e1 ty ha =
        LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt (HList.append bv₁ bv₂) e2 ty hc
    · rw [denote_eq_true _ ha hc h₁ hv,
        denote_eq_true _ ha' hc' h₂ (by rwa [← hleft, ← hright])]
    · rw [denote_eq_false _ ha hc h₁ hv,
        denote_eq_false _ ha' hc' h₂ (by rwa [← hleft, ← hright])]
  | abs _ _ ty body ih =>
    cases ty with
    | none => exact absurd (LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h₁) (by simp [LExpr.typeCheck])
    | some aty =>
      obtain ⟨_, he, hb⟩ := HasTypeA.abs_inv h₁
      obtain ⟨_, he', hb'⟩ := HasTypeA.abs_inv h₂
      subst he; cases he'
      rw [denote_abs _ hb h₁, denote_abs _ hb' h₂]
      funext x
      exact ih (by simpa [LExpr.lcAt] using h_lc) hb hb' (.cons x bv₁)
  | quant _ qk _ ty tr body ih_tr ih =>
    cases ty with
    | none => exact absurd (LExpr.HasTypeA_to_typeCheck h₁) (by simp [LExpr.typeCheck])
    | some qty =>
      simp only [LExpr.lcAt, Bool.and_eq_true] at h_lc
      obtain ⟨_, he, _, hb⟩ := HasTypeA.quant_inv h₁
      obtain ⟨_, he', _, hb'⟩ := HasTypeA.quant_inv h₂
      subst he; cases he'
      exact denote_quant_congr hb hb' h₁ h₂ fun x =>
        ih (by simpa using h_lc.2) hb hb' (.cons x bv₁)

name: Lambda.denote_Denotes
proof:
theorem denote_Denotes
    {T : LExprParams}
    (tcInterp : TyConstrInterp)
    (opInterp : OpInterp tcInterp)
    (fvarVal : FreeVarVal T tcInterp)
    (vt : TyVarVal)
    {Δ : List LMonoTy}
    (bvarVal : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ)
    (e : LExpr T.mono) (τ : LMonoTy)
    (h : LExpr.HasTypeA Δ e τ)
    : Denotes tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt bvarVal e τ h
        (LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt bvarVal e τ h) := by
  classical
  induction e generalizing Δ τ with
  | abs _ _ ty body ih =>
    cases ty with
    | none => cases h
    | some aty =>
      rcases hi : HasTypeA.abs_inv h with ⟨rty, rfl, hb⟩
      simp only [LExpr.denote, hi]
      exact .abs bvarVal fun x => ih (.cons x bvarVal) _ hb
  | app _ fn arg ihf iha =>
    rcases hi : HasTypeA.app_inv h with ⟨aty, hf, ha⟩
    simp only [LExpr.denote, hi]
    exact .app bvarVal (ihf bvarVal _ hf) (iha bvarVal _ ha)
  | ite _ c t e' ihc iht ihe =>
    unfold LExpr.denote
    split
    rename_i _ hc ht he
    dsimp only
    split <;> rename_i hv
    · exact .ite_true bvarVal (hv ▸ ihc bvarVal _ hc) (iht bvarVal _ ht)
    · exact .ite_false bvarVal (Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hv ▸ ihc bvarVal _ hc) (ihe bvarVal _ he)
  | eq _ e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
    rcases hi : HasTypeA.eq_inv h with ⟨ty, rfl, h1, h2⟩
    simp only [LExpr.denote, hi]
    cases hv : (Classical.propDecidable _).decide
    · exact .eq_false bvarVal (ih1 bvarVal _ h1) (ih2 bvarVal _ h2) (of_decide_eq_false hv)
    · exact .eq_true bvarVal (ih1 bvarVal _ h1) (of_decide_eq_true hv ▸ ih2 bvarVal _ h2)
  | quant _ k _ ty tr body ihtr ih =>
    cases ty with
    | none => cases h
    | some qty =>
      rcases hi : HasTypeA.quant_inv h with ⟨tt, rfl, ht, hb⟩
      simp only [LExpr.denote, hi]
      have ihv := fun x => ih (.cons x bvarVal) _ hb
      cases k <;> cases hv : (Classical.propDecidable _).decide
      · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Classical.not_forall.mp (of_decide_eq_false hv)
        exact .quant_all_false bvarVal w (Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hw ▸ ihv w)
      · exact .quant_all_true bvarVal fun x => of_decide_eq_true hv x ▸ ihv x
      · exact .quant_exist_false bvarVal fun x => Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr (not_exists.mp (of_decide_eq_false hv) x) ▸ ihv x
      · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hv
        exact .quant_exist_true bvarVal w (hw ▸ ihv w)
  | _ => cases h; constructor

name: Lambda.callOfLFunc_eraseMetadata_congr
proof:
theorem callOfLFunc_eraseMetadata_congr
    (F : @Factory Tbase) (e₁ e₂ : LExpr Tbase.mono) (aPA : Bool)
    (h_eM : e₁.eraseMetadata = e₂.eraseMetadata) :
    match F.callOfLFunc e₁ (allowPartialApp := aPA), F.callOfLFunc e₂ (allowPartialApp := aPA) with
    | some (op₁, args₁, f₁), some (op₂, args₂, f₂) =>
        f₁ = f₂ ∧ args₁.map LExpr.eraseMetadata = args₂.map LExpr.eraseMetadata
        ∧ op₁.eraseMetadata = op₂.eraseMetadata
    | none, none => True
    | _, _ => False := by
  have h := getLFuncCall_eraseMetadata_congr e₁ e₂ h_eM
  unfold Factory.callOfLFunc
  revert h
  obtain ⟨op₁, args₁⟩ := getLFuncCall e₁
  obtain ⟨op₂, args₂⟩ := getLFuncCall e₂
  intro h
  cases EMEquiv.of_eraseMetadata_eq _ _ h.1 <;> try trivial
  rename_i m₁ n t m₂
  have hl := congrArg List.length h.2
  simp at hl
  simp only [hl]
  cases F[n.name]? with
  | none => trivial
  | some f =>
    dsimp
    cases (if aPA then Nat.ble args₂.length f.inputs.length else args₂.length == f.inputs.length) <;>
      simp [h]

name: Lambda.liftBVars_typeCheck
proof:
theorem liftBVars_typeCheck
    (e : LExpr T.mono)
    {Δ₁ Δ_insert Δ_outer : List LMonoTy}
    : LExpr.typeCheck (Δ₁ ++ Δ_insert ++ Δ_outer) (LExpr.liftBVars Δ_insert.length e Δ₁.length)
      = LExpr.typeCheck (Δ₁ ++ Δ_outer) e := by
  induction e generalizing Δ₁ <;> try cases ‹Option LMonoTy›
  all_goals simp_all only [LExpr.liftBVars, LExpr.typeCheck]
  all_goals try simp_all only [← List.cons_append, ← List.length_cons (a := ‹LMonoTy›)]
  all_goals split <;> simp only [LExpr.typeCheck] <;> grind

name: Lambda.liftBVars_denote
proof:
theorem liftBVars_denote
    {e : LExpr T.mono} {τ : LMonoTy}
    {Δ₁ Δ_insert Δ_outer : List LMonoTy}
    (h_orig : LExpr.HasTypeA (Δ₁ ++ Δ_outer) e τ)
    (h_lifted : LExpr.HasTypeA (Δ₁ ++ (Δ_insert ++ Δ_outer)) (LExpr.liftBVars Δ_insert.length e Δ₁.length) τ)
    (bv₁ : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ₁)
    (bv_insert : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ_insert)
    (bv_outer : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ_outer)
    : LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt (HList.append bv₁ (HList.append bv_insert bv_outer))
        (LExpr.liftBVars Δ_insert.length e Δ₁.length) τ h_lifted =
      LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt (HList.append bv₁ bv_outer) e τ h_orig := by
  have liftTy {Δ : List LMonoTy} {a : LExpr T.mono} {t : LMonoTy}
      (h : LExpr.HasTypeA (Δ ++ Δ_outer) a t) :
      LExpr.HasTypeA (Δ ++ (Δ_insert ++ Δ_outer)) (LExpr.liftBVars Δ_insert.length a Δ.length) t := by
    simpa only [LExpr.HasTypeA_iff_typeCheck, ← List.append_assoc, liftBVars_typeCheck] using h
  induction e generalizing Δ₁ bv₁ τ <;> simp only [LExpr.liftBVars] at h_lifted ⊢
  case const => rfl
  case op m o ty => cases h_orig; rfl
  case fvar m name ty => cases h_orig; rfl
  case bvar m i =>
    by_cases hg : Δ₁.length ≤ i <;> simp only [hg, ↓reduceIte] at h_lifted ⊢
    all_goals rw [denote_bvar _ _ _ _ _ h_lifted, denote_bvar _ _ _ _ _ h_orig]
    · have ho := HasTypeA.bvar_inv h_orig
      rw [List.getElem?_append_right hg] at ho
      have hm := HasTypeA.bvar_inv h_lifted
      rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega : Δ₁.length ≤ i + Δ_insert.length)] at hm
      have hi : i + Δ_insert.length - Δ₁.length - Δ_insert.length = i - Δ₁.length := by omega
      rw [HList.get_append_right bv₁ (bv_insert.append bv_outer) _ _ hm (by omega),
        HList.get_append_right bv_insert bv_outer _ hm (by simpa only [hi] using ho) (by omega),
        HList.get_append_right bv₁ bv_outer _ _ ho hg]
      simp only [hi]
    · have hp := HasTypeA.bvar_inv h_orig
      rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by omega : i < Δ₁.length)] at hp
      rw [HList.get_append_left bv₁ (bv_insert.append bv_outer) i _ hp,
        HList.get_append_left bv₁ bv_outer i _ hp]
  case app m fn arg ih_fn ih_arg =>
    let ⟨aty, hf, ha⟩ := HasTypeA.app_inv h_orig
    rw [denote_app _ (liftTy hf) (liftTy ha) h_lifted, denote_app _ hf ha h_orig,
      ih_fn hf _ bv₁, ih_arg ha _ bv₁]
  case abs m name ty body ih =>
    cases h_orig with
    | abs hb =>
      have hl := liftTy (Δ := _ :: Δ₁) hb
      exact (denote_abs _ hl h_lifted).trans
        ((funext fun x => ih hb hl (.cons x bv₁)).trans (denote_abs _ hb (.abs hb)).symm)
  case ite m c t e ih_c ih_t ih_e =>
    let ⟨hc, ht, he⟩ := HasTypeA.ite_inv h_orig
    rw [denote_ite _ (liftTy hc) (liftTy ht) (liftTy he) h_lifted,
      denote_ite _ hc ht he h_orig,
      ih_c hc _ bv₁, ih_t ht _ bv₁, ih_e he _ bv₁]
  case eq m e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
    let ⟨ty, he, h1, h2⟩ := HasTypeA.eq_inv h_orig
    subst he
    have hh1 := ih1 h1 (liftTy h1) bv₁
    have hh2 := ih2 h2 (liftTy h2) bv₁
    apply Classical.byCases
    · intro heq
      rw [denote_eq_true _ h1 h2 h_orig heq]
      exact denote_eq_true _ _ _ h_lifted (by rw [hh1, hh2]; exact heq)
    · intro heq
      rw [denote_eq_false _ h1 h2 h_orig heq]
      exact denote_eq_false _ _ _ h_lifted (by rw [hh1, hh2]; exact heq)
  case quant m qk name qty tr body ih_tr ih_body =>
    cases h_orig with
    | quant ht hb =>
      have hl := liftTy (Δ := _ :: Δ₁) hb
      exact denote_quant_congr hl hb h_lifted (.quant ht hb) fun x =>
        ih_body hb hl (.cons x bv₁)

name: Lambda.LExpr.typeCheck_to_HasTypeA
proof:
theorem LExpr.typeCheck_to_HasTypeA {T : LExprParams} {Δ : List LMonoTy}
    {e : LExpr T.mono} {τ : LMonoTy}
    (h : typeCheck Δ e = some τ) : HasTypeA Δ e τ := by
  induction e generalizing Δ τ
  all_goals try cases ‹Option LMonoTy›
  all_goals simp only [typeCheck, bind, Option.bind_eq_some_iff, guard, pure, failure, beq_iff_eq, Option.ite_none_right_eq_some, Option.some.injEq, reduceCtorEq, and_true] at h
  case const | op.some | fvar.some => cases h; constructor
  case bvar => exact .bvar h
  case' abs.some => rcases h with ⟨_, hb, rfl⟩
  case' quant.some => rcases h with ⟨_, ht, _, hb, _, rfl, rfl⟩
  case' app =>
    rcases h with ⟨_, hf, _, ha, ⟨_, _⟩, hp, _, rfl, rfl⟩
    obtain rfl := LMonoTy.isArrow_some hp
  case' ite => rcases h with ⟨_, hc, _, ht, _, he, _, rfl, _, rfl, rfl⟩
  case' eq => rcases h with ⟨_, ha, _, hb, _, rfl, rfl⟩
  all_goals constructor <;> (apply_assumption <;> assumption)

name: Lambda.callOfLFunc_constr_disjoint_denote
proof:
theorem callOfLFunc_constr_disjoint_denote
    {T : LExprParams} [DecidableEq T.IDMeta] [Inhabited T.mono.base.IDMeta]
    (tcInterp : TyConstrInterp) (opInterp : OpInterp tcInterp)
    (fvarVal : FreeVarVal T tcInterp) (vt : TyVarVal)
    {F : @Factory T} {tf : @TypeFactory T.IDMeta}
    {e₁ e₂ : LExpr T.mono} {τ : LMonoTy}
    {callee₁ callee₂ : LExpr T.mono}
    {args₁ args₂ : List (LExpr T.mono)}
    {f₁ f₂ : LFunc T.mono.base}
    (h₁ : LExpr.HasTypeA [] e₁ τ)
    (h₂ : LExpr.HasTypeA [] e₂ τ)
    (hcall₁ : Factory.callOfLFunc F e₁ = some (callee₁, args₁, f₁))
    (hcall₂ : Factory.callOfLFunc F e₂ = some (callee₂, args₂, f₂))
    (hconstr₁ : f₁.isConstr = true) (hconstr₂ : f₂.isConstr = true)
    (hdiffname : f₁.name.name ≠ f₂.name.name)
    (hoc₁ : OpsConsistent F e₁) (hoc₂ : OpsConsistent F e₂)
    (hfwf : FactoryWF F) (hcwf : Factory.ConstrWellFormed F tf)
    (htfwf : TypeFactoryWF tf)
    (hConstrIC : ConstrInterpConsistent tcInterp opInterp F)
    : LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt .nil e₁ τ h₁ ≠
      LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt .nil e₂ τ h₂ := by
  obtain ⟨argTys₁, _, m₁, name₁, h_args₁, rfl, hcallee₁, hdenote₁⟩ :=
    callOfLFunc_denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt hcall₁ h₁
  obtain ⟨argTys₂, _, m₂, name₂, h_args₂, rfl, hcallee₂, hdenote₂⟩ :=
    callOfLFunc_denote tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt hcall₂ h₂
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hcallee₁', hget₁⟩ := Factory.callOfLFunc_getElem? hcall₁
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hcallee₂', hget₂⟩ := Factory.callOfLFunc_getElem? hcall₂
  rw [hcallee₁] at hcallee₁'; cases hcallee₁'
  rw [hcallee₂] at hcallee₂'; cases hcallee₂'
  rw [hdenote₁, hdenote₂, ← Factory.getElem?_name hget₁, ← Factory.getElem?_name hget₂]
  obtain ⟨tySubst₁, _, htySubst₁⟩ := OpsConsistent_callOfLFunc hoc₁ hcall₁
  have hty_op_subst₁ := htySubst₁ m₁ name₁ _ hcallee₁
  rw [subst_mkArrow'] at hty_op_subst₁
  have ⟨hτ_eq₁, hargTys_eq₁⟩ := LMonoTy.mkArrow'_injective (h := hty_op_subst₁) (by
    simpa only [List.length_map] using h_args₁.length_eq.symm.trans (Factory.callOfLFunc_arity hcall₁))
  let vt'₁ : TyVarVal := fun x => match tySubst₁.find? x with
    | some t => LMonoTy.substTyVars vt t | none => vt x
  obtain ⟨tySubst₂, _, htySubst₂⟩ := OpsConsistent_callOfLFunc hoc₂ hcall₂
  have hty_op_subst₂ := htySubst₂ m₂ name₂ _ hcallee₂
  rw [subst_mkArrow'] at hty_op_subst₂
  have ⟨hτ_eq₂, hargTys_eq₂⟩ := LMonoTy.mkArrow'_injective (h := hty_op_subst₂) (by
    simpa only [List.length_map] using h_args₂.length_eq.symm.trans (Factory.callOfLFunc_arity hcall₂))
  have hmem₁ := callOfLFunc_func_mem _ _ _ _ _ false hcall₁
  have hmem₂ := callOfLFunc_func_mem _ _ _ _ _ false hcall₂
  obtain ⟨d₁, hd₁_mem, c₁, _, hf₁_eq⟩ := hcwf f₁ hmem₁ hconstr₁
  obtain ⟨d₂, hd₂_mem, c₂, _, hf₂_eq⟩ := hcwf f₂ hmem₂ hconstr₂
  have ho₁ : f₁.output = dataDefault d₁ := by subst hf₁_eq; rfl
  have ho₂ : f₂.output = dataDefault d₂ := by subst hf₂_eq; rfl
  cases htfwf.eq_of_name_eq hd₁_mem hd₂_mem (by
    have h := hτ_eq₁.symm.trans hτ_eq₂
    rw [ho₁, ho₂] at h
    unfold dataDefault data at h
    rw [LMonoTy.subst_tcons, LMonoTy.subst_tcons] at h
    exact (LMonoTy.tcons.inj h).1)
  have h_same_output := ho₁.trans ho₂.symm
  have h_subst_inputs_eq := constr_same_output_implies_same_argTys
    (S₁ := tySubst₁) (S₂ := tySubst₂)
    (hfwf.lfuncs_wf f₂ hmem₂)
    (by rw [← h_same_output, ← hτ_eq₁, h_same_output, ← hτ_eq₂])
    (constrFunc_output_covers_typeArgs hcwf hmem₂ hconstr₂)
  have hdisj := hConstrIC.constr_disjoint f₁ f₂ hmem₁ hmem₂ hconstr₁ hconstr₂ hdiffname vt'₁
  dsimp only at hdisj
  rw [← h_same_output] at hdisj
  unfold TyVarVal at vt vt'₁
  have hvt : LMonoTy.substTyVars vt'₁ = LMonoTy.substTyVars vt ∘ LMonoTy.subst tySubst₁ :=
    funext fun ty => (substTyVars_subst vt tySubst₁ ty).symm
  rw [hvt, ListMap.values_eq_map_snd, ListMap.values_eq_map_snd,
    ← List.map_map, ← List.map_map, ← hargTys_eq₁, h_subst_inputs_eq,
    ← hargTys_eq₂, Function.comp_apply, ← hτ_eq₁] at hdisj
  have hop (n : String) {s t : LSort} (h : s = t) :

  simpa only [hop] using
    hdisj rfl (denoteArgs tcInterp opInterp fvarVal vt .nil args₁ argTys₁ h_args₁)

name: Lambda.denote_ext
proof:
theorem denote_ext
    {e : LExpr T.mono} {τ : LMonoTy}
    {Δ : List LMonoTy}
    {opInterp₁ opInterp₂ : OpInterp tcInterp}
    {fvarVal₁ fvarVal₂ : FreeVarVal T tcInterp}
    {bvarVal₁ bvarVal₂ : BVarVal tcInterp vt Δ}
    (h_op : ∀ o ty, (o, some ty) ∈ e.usedOps → opInterp₁ o.name (LMonoTy.substTyVars vt ty) = opInterp₂ o.name (LMonoTy.substTyVars vt ty))
    (h_fvar : ∀ name ty, (name, some ty) ∈ e.freeVars → fvarVal₁ name (LMonoTy.substTyVars vt ty) = fvarVal₂ name (LMonoTy.substTyVars vt ty))
    (h_bvar : ∀ i (τ' : LMonoTy) (h₁ : Δ[i]? = some τ') (h₂ : Δ[i]? = some τ'), i ∈ e.usedBvars → bvarVal₁.get i h₁ = bvarVal₂.get i h₂)
    (h₁ : LExpr.HasTypeA Δ e τ)
    (h₂ : LExpr.HasTypeA Δ e τ)
    : LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp₁ fvarVal₁ vt bvarVal₁ e τ h₁ =
      LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp₂ fvarVal₂ vt bvarVal₂ e τ h₂ := by
  change _ = LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp₂ fvarVal₂ vt bvarVal₂ e τ h₁
  clear h₂
  revert h_op h_fvar h_bvar
  induction h₁ <;> intro ho hf hb
  case const => rfl
  case op => exact ho _ _ (List.Mem.head _)
  case fvar => exact hf _ _ (List.Mem.head _)
  case bvar hi => exact hb _ _ hi hi (List.Mem.head _)
  case abs ht ih =>
    rw [denote_abs _ ht, denote_abs _ ht]
    funext x
    exact ih ho hf (bvar_ext_cons tcInterp vt x hb)
  case quant ht hu iht ihu =>
    apply denote_quant_congr hu hu
    intro x
    exact ihu (fun o ty h => ho o ty (List.mem_append_right _ h))
      (fun n ty h => hf n ty (List.mem_append_right _ h))
      (bvar_ext_cons tcInterp vt x (fun i ty h₁ h₂ h => hb i ty h₁ h₂ (List.mem_append_right _ h)))
  all_goals simp (config := { dsimp := false }) only [LExpr.usedOps, LExpr.freeVars, LExpr.usedBvars, List.mem_append, or_imp, forall_and] at ho hf hb
  case app ht hu iht ihu =>
    rw [denote_app _ ht hu, denote_app _ ht hu,
      iht ho.1 hf.1 hb.1, ihu ho.2 hf.2 hb.2]
  case ite hc ht hu ihc iht ihu =>
    rw [denote_ite _ hc ht hu, denote_ite _ hc ht hu,
      ihc ho.1.1 hf.1.1 hb.1.1, iht ho.1.2 hf.1.2 hb.1.2, ihu ho.2 hf.2 hb.2]
  case eq ht hu iht ihu =>
    have hleft := iht ho.1 hf.1 hb.1
    have hright := ihu ho.2 hf.2 hb.2
    by_cases h : LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp₁ fvarVal₁ vt bvarVal₁ _ _ ht = LExpr.denote tcInterp opInterp₁ fvarVal₁ vt bvarVal₁ _ _ hu
    · exact (denote_eq_true _ ht hu _ h).trans
        (denote_eq_true _ ht hu _ (hleft.symm.trans (h.trans hright))).symm
    · exact (denote_eq_false _ ht hu _ h).trans
        (denote_eq_false _ ht hu _ (fun hh => h (hleft.trans (hh.trans hright.symm)))).symm

name: LeanPool.Erdos132ConvexK3.erlv_case12_other_d1_bone_impossible
proof:
theorem erlv_case12_other_d1_bone_impossible
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P : Fin n → Point ℝ} {d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℝ}
    (S : ErLVAtVertexUseSite P d₁ d₂ d₃) (h12 : S.Case12)
    (hOther : sqDist
      (P (cyclicRetreat (firstClockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃ S.x)
        S.pair.first.leftMoves))
      (P (cyclicAdvance S.x 1)) = d₁)
    (hBOne : S.pair.first.leftMoves = 1) : False := by
  let x := S.x
  let p := cyclicAdvance x 1
  let q := cyclicAdvance x 2
  let u := firstCounterclockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃ (cyclicAdvance x 3)
  let z := firstClockwiseNeighbor P d₁ d₂ d₃ x
  let s := cyclicRetreat z 1
  let uoff := erlvUOffset S
  let zoff := erlvZOffset S
  let soff := zoff - 1
  have hOffsets := erlv_u_z_offset_data S
  have huoff3 : 3 < uoff := hOffsets.1
  have huz : uoff + 3 ≤ zoff := hOffsets.2.1
  have hzoffn : zoff < n := hOffsets.2.2.1
  have hsoffn : soff < n := by dsimp [soff]; omega
  have huS : uoff < soff := by dsimp [soff]; omega
  have hsZ : soff < zoff := by dsimp [soff]; omega
  have huIndex : u = cyclicAdvance x uoff := hOffsets.2.2.2.1
  have hzIndex : z = cyclicAdvance x zoff := hOffsets.2.2.2.2
  have hsIndex : s = cyclicAdvance x soff := by
    dsimp [s]
    rw [hzIndex]
    exact cyclicRetreat_advance x (k := zoff) (m := 1) (by omega) hzoffn
  have hData := erlv_case12_shared_tip_rank_data S h12
  have hpu : sqDist (P p) (P u) = d₁ := hData.1
  have hqu : sqDist (P q) (P u) = d₂ := hData.2.2
  have hsp : sqDist (P s) (P p) = d₁ := by
    rw [hBOne] at hOther
    exact hOther
  have hps : sqDist (P p) (P s) = d₁ := by
    simpa only [sqDist_comm] using hsp
  have hpzNe : sqDist (P p) (P z) ≠ d₁ := by
    intro hpz
    have hquad₁ : StrictConvexQuad (P p) (P q) (P u) (P s) := by
      have h := cyclic_strict_convex_quad_offsets S.convex x
        (a := 1) (b := 2) (c := uoff) (d := soff)
        (by omega) (by omega) huS hsoffn
      rw [← huIndex, ← hsIndex] at h
      exact h
    have hquad₂ : StrictConvexQuad (P p) (P q) (P s) (P z) := by
      have h := cyclic_strict_convex_quad_offsets S.convex x
        (a := 1) (b := 2) (c := soff) (d := zoff)
        (by omega) (by omega) hsZ hzoffn
      rw [← hsIndex, ← hzIndex] at h
      exact h
    have hgrow₁ := equal_radius_arc_strict_order hquad₁ (hpu.trans hps.symm)
    have hgrow₂ := equal_radius_arc_strict_order hquad₂ (hps.trans hpz.symm)
    have hqsNe : q ≠ s := by
      rw [hsIndex]
      exact cyclicAdvance_ne_of_lt x (by omega) hsoffn (by omega)
    have hqzNe : q ≠ z := by
      rw [hzIndex]
      exact cyclicAdvance_ne_of_lt x (by omega) hzoffn (by omega)
    have hbz := (top_three_class_bounds_of_ne S.classes hqzNe).1
    have hbs := (top_three_class_bounds_of_ne S.classes hqsNe).2.1
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hgrow₂ hbz)
    linarith only [hgrow₁, hqu, hbs]
  have hFirstPath : K3CoverSequence P z x 1 1 := by
    simpa only [z, x, hBOne, h12.1] using S.pair.first.path
  have hStart : TopThreeAdjacent P d₁ d₂ d₃ z x := S.first_start_adjacent
  have hRanks : sqDist (P x) (P z) = d₃ ∧ sqDist (P p) (P z) = d₂ := by
    cases hFirstPath with
    | left hLeft tailPath =>
      cases tailPath with
      | right hRight _ =>
        have hMid := left_cover_top_three_adjacent S.classes hStart hLeft
        have hr := strict_three_rank_chain S.classes.1 S.classes.2.1
          hStart.2 hMid.2 (Or.inl hsp) hLeft hRight
        have hxz : sqDist (P x) (P z) = d₃ := by
          simpa only [sqDist_comm] using hr.1
        have hxs : sqDist (P x) (P s) = d₂ := by
          simpa only [sqDist_comm] using hr.2.1
        have hquad : StrictConvexQuad (P x) (P p) (P s) (P z) := by
          have h := cyclic_strict_convex_quad_offsets S.convex x
            (a := 0) (b := 1) (c := soff) (d := zoff)
            (by omega) (by omega) hsZ hzoffn
          rw [← hsIndex, ← hzIndex] at h
          simpa [p] using h
        have hcompare := far_arc_strict_center_comparison hquad
          (show sqDist (P x) (P s) ≤ sqDist (P p) (P s) by
            rw [hxs, hps]
            exact le_of_lt S.classes.2.1)
        have hpzAdj := top_three_adjacent_of_strictly_longer S.classes
          (topThreeAdjacent_symm hStart) hcompare
        refine ⟨hxz, ?_⟩
        rcases hpzAdj.2 with h | h | h
        · exact (hpzNe h).elim
        · exact h
        · linarith only [hxz, h, hcompare]
    | right hRight tailPath =>
      cases tailPath with
      | left hLeft _ =>
        have hMid := right_cover_top_three_adjacent S.classes hStart hRight
        have hr := strict_three_rank_chain S.classes.1 S.classes.2.1
          hStart.2 hMid.2 (Or.inl hsp) hRight hLeft
        constructor
        · simpa only [sqDist_comm] using hr.1
        · simpa only [sqDist_comm] using hr.2.1
  have hxu := d1_d3_opposite_sides_force_xu_top_two S.classes
    (erlv_x_p_u_z_strict_convex_quad S)
    (topThreeAdjacent_symm S.first_start_adjacent) hpu hRanks.1 hRanks.2
  have hbounds := maximal_gap_tail_degree_bounds S hpu hRanks.1 hRanks.2
  rcases hxu with h | h
  · exact high_degree_le_six_false S S.x (hbounds.1 h)
  · exact high_degree_le_six_false S S.x ((hbounds.2 h).trans (by omega))

name: CoxeterSystem.matsumoto_reduced_aux
proof:
theorem matsumoto_reduced_aux [MatsumotoCondition cs] (p : ℕ) (l l' : List B)
(len_l_eq_p : l.length = p) (len_l'_eq_p : l'.length = p)
(l_reduced : cs.IsReduced l) (l'_reduced : cs.IsReduced l') (h_eq : π l = π l') :
  ∃ bms : List (cs.BraidMove), cs.applyBraidMoveSequence bms l = l' := by
  induction p generalizing l l' with
  | zero =>
    rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp len_l_eq_p, List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp len_l'_eq_p]
    exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | succ p ih =>
    obtain ⟨i, u, rfl, hu⟩ := cons_of_length_succ l len_l_eq_p
    obtain ⟨j, v, rfl, hv⟩ := cons_of_length_succ l' len_l'_eq_p
    have step := fun a x y hx hy =>
      cs.matsumoto_reduced_inductionStep_of_firstLetterEq p x y a
        (Nat.succ.inj hx) (Nat.succ.inj hy) (ih := ih)
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      exact step i u v len_l_eq_p len_l'_eq_p h_eq l_reduced l'_reduced
    · have bridge (a b : B) (t x y : List B)
          (ht : π (i :: u) = π (braidWord M a b ++ t))
          (hr : cs.IsReduced (braidWord M a b ++ t))
          (hx : braidWord M a b ++ t = i :: x)
          (hy : braidWord M b a ++ t = j :: y) :
          ∃ bms, cs.applyBraidMoveSequence bms (i :: u) = j :: v := by
        have he : π (braidWord M a b ++ t) = π (braidWord M b a ++ t) := by
          rw [wordProd_append, wordProd_append, cs.wordProd_braidWord_eq a b]
        have hs := cs.isReduced_of_eq_length _ _
          (by simp only [List.length_append, length_alternatingWord, M.symmetric a b]) he hr
        simp only [hx, hy] at ht hr he hs
        have la := (cs.eq_length_of_isReduced _ _ ht l_reduced hr).symm.trans len_l_eq_p
        have hb := he.symm.trans (ht.symm.trans h_eq)
        have lb := (cs.eq_length_of_isReduced _ _ hb hs l'_reduced).trans len_l'_eq_p
        obtain ⟨bs, hs₁⟩ := step i u x len_l_eq_p la ht l_reduced hr
        obtain ⟨bs', hs₂⟩ := step j y v lb len_l'_eq_p hb hs l'_reduced
        refine ⟨bs' ++ BraidMove.mk a b 0 :: bs, ?_⟩
        rw [apply_braidMove_sequence_append, apply_braidMoveSequence_cons, hs₁, ← hx,
          applyBraidMove, ← length_alternatingWord a b (M a b), List.take_left,
          if_pos rfl, List.drop_left, hy, hs₂]
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, M i j = n + 1 :=
        ⟨M i j - 1, by simp [MatsumotoCondition.one_le_M cs i j]⟩
      have hn' := (M.symmetric j i).trans hn
      by_cases hnEven : Even n
      · obtain ⟨t, ht, hr⟩ := cs.prefix_braidWord v u j i (Ne.symm hij) h_eq.symm l'_reduced l_reduced
        apply bridge j i t (alternatingWord j i n ++ t) (alternatingWord i j n ++ t) (h_eq.trans ht) hr <;>
          simp only [braidWord, hn, hn', alternatingWord_succ', if_pos hnEven, List.cons_append]
      · obtain ⟨t, ht, hr⟩ := cs.prefix_braidWord u v i j hij h_eq l_reduced l'_reduced
        apply bridge i j t (alternatingWord i j n ++ t) (alternatingWord j i n ++ t) ht hr <;>
          simp only [braidWord, hn, hn', alternatingWord_succ', if_neg hnEven, List.cons_append]

name: Vlasov.transportedIntegral_continuousOn
proof:
theorem transportedIntegral_continuousOn
    (gradW : PhysSpace d → PhysSpace d)
    (f : ℝ → Measure (PhaseSpace d)) (T : ℝ)
    (hf_mom : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, HasFiniteFirstMoment (f t))
    (hf_narrow : ∀ (g : PhaseSpace d → ℝ), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g →
      ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ z, g z ∂(f s)) (Set.Icc 0 T))
    (charX charV : ℝ → PhaseSpace d → PhysSpace d)
    (hflow : IsCharacteristicFlowOn gradW (fun t => spatialMarginal (f t)) charX charV
      (Set.Ioo 0 T) Set.univ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)
    (φ : PhaseSpace d → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (Ψ : ℝ → PhaseSpace d → PhaseSpace d)
    (hΨ_left : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
      Function.LeftInverse (Ψ s) (fun z => (charX s z, charV s z)))
    (hΨ_right : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
      Function.RightInverse (Ψ s) (fun z => (charX s z, charV s z)))
    (hΨ_C1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun p : ℝ × PhaseSpace d => Ψ p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Ioo 0 T ×ˢ Set.univ))
    (hΦt_C1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun z : PhaseSpace d => (charX t z, charV t z)))
    (L : NNReal)
    (hflowjoint : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × PhaseSpace d => (charX p.1 p.2, charV p.1 p.2))
      (Set.Icc 0 T ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (PhaseSpace d))))
    (hanti : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ z₁ z₂ : PhaseSpace d,
      dist z₁ z₂ ≤ dist ((charX s z₁, charV s z₁) : PhaseSpace d) (charX s z₂, charV s z₂)
        * Real.exp (((max 1 L : NNReal) : ℝ) * s)) :
    ContinuousOn (fun s => if s = 0 then ∫ z, φ (charX t z, charV t z) ∂(f 0)
        else ∫ z, φ (charX t (Ψ s z), charV t (Ψ s z)) ∂(f s)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t) := by
  classical
  let S : Set (ℝ × PhaseSpace d) := Set.Icc 0 t ×ˢ Set.univ
  let H : ℝ × PhaseSpace d → PhaseSpace d := fun p => if p.1 = 0 then p.2 else Ψ p.1 p.2
  have hinit : ∀ z, (charX 0 z, charV 0 z) = z := fun z =>
    Prod.ext (hflow.1 z (Set.mem_univ z)).1 (hflow.1 z (Set.mem_univ z)).2
  have hright : ∀ p ∈ S, (charX p.1 (H p), charV p.1 (H p)) = p.2 := by
    intro p hp
    by_cases h : p.1 = 0
    · simp only [H, h, if_pos, hinit]
    · simpa only [H, if_neg h] using
        hΨ_right p.1 ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hp.1.1 (Ne.symm h), lt_of_le_of_lt hp.1.2 ht.2⟩ p.2
  have he : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × PhaseSpace d => Real.exp (((max 1 L : NNReal) : ℝ) * q.1)) :=
    Real.continuous_exp.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_fst)
  have hH : ContinuousOn H S := by
    intro p hp
    have hc : ContinuousWithinAt (fun q : ℝ × PhaseSpace d => (charX q.1 (H p), charV q.1 (H p))) S p :=
      (hflowjoint.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
        (fun q hq => ⟨⟨hq.1.1, le_trans hq.1.2 ht.2.le⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩)) p hp
    have hu := (continuous_snd.continuousWithinAt.dist hc).mul he.continuousWithinAt
    rw [ContinuousWithinAt, tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
    refine squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun q => dist_nonneg) ?_ (by
      simpa only [hright p hp, dist_self, zero_mul] using hu)
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with q hq
    by_cases hq0 : q.1 = 0
    · simp only [H, hq0, if_pos, hinit, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one, le_refl]
    · have hh := hanti q.1 ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hq.1.1 (Ne.symm hq0), lt_of_le_of_lt hq.1.2 ht.2⟩ (H q) (H p)
      rwa [hright q hq] at hh
  let c : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => ↑(Set.projIcc 0 t ht.1.le r)
  have hc : Continuous c := continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_projIcc
  have hcm : ∀ r, c r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t := fun r => (Set.projIcc 0 t ht.1.le r).2
  have hcid : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t, c r = r := fun r hr =>
    congrArg Subtype.val (Set.projIcc_of_mem ht.1.le hr)
  let G : ℝ → PhaseSpace d → ℝ := fun r z => φ (charX t (H (c r,z)), charV t (H (c r,z)))
  have hGc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × PhaseSpace d => G p.1 p.2) :=
    hφ.continuous.comp (hΦt_C1.continuous.comp
      (hH.comp_continuous (hc.comp continuous_fst |>.prodMk continuous_snd)
        (fun p => ⟨hcm p.1, Set.mem_univ _⟩)))
  have hΨtc : Continuous (Ψ t) := hΨ_C1.continuousOn.comp_continuous
    (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id) (fun z => ⟨ht, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
  let C := Ψ t '' tsupport φ
  have hC : IsCompact C := hφc.image hΨtc
  let K := (fun p : ℝ × PhaseSpace d => (charX p.1 p.2, charV p.1 p.2)) '' (Set.Icc 0 t ×ˢ C)
  have hK : IsCompact K := (isCompact_Icc.prod hC).image_of_continuousOn
    (hflowjoint.mono fun p hp => ⟨⟨hp.1.1, le_trans hp.1.2 ht.2.le⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
  have hsupp : ∀ r, ∀ z ∉ K, G r z = 0 := by
    intro r z hz
    by_contra hn
    have hm : (charX t (H (c r,z)), charV t (H (c r,z))) ∈ tsupport φ :=
      subset_tsupport _ hn
    have hmem : H (c r,z) ∈ C :=
      ⟨_, hm, hΨ_left t ht (H (c r,z))⟩
    exact hz ⟨(c r,H (c r,z)), ⟨hcm r,hmem⟩, hright (c r,z) ⟨hcm r, Set.mem_univ _⟩⟩
  have hcont := vlasovSolutionOn_integral_continuousOn f T hf_mom hf_narrow G hGc K hK hsupp
  apply (hcont.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right ht.2.le)).congr
  intro r hr
  simp only [G, hcid r hr, H, Prod.fst, Prod.snd]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst r
    rfl
  · rfl

proof:
lemma step1_double :
    2 * ∫ α in (0:ℝ)..1, α * extremalSelfConv α
      = ∫ u in (-(1:ℝ)/2)..(1/2),
          extremalTest u * ∫ v in (-(1:ℝ)/2)..(1/2), |u - v| * extremalTest v := by
  set a : ℝ := -(1:ℝ)/2 with ha
  set b : ℝ := (1:ℝ)/2 with hb
  have hab : a ≤ b := by norm_num [ha, hb]
  have hneg (f : ℝ → ℝ) : (∫ x in a..b, f (-x)) = ∫ x in a..b, f x := by
    simpa only [ha, hb, neg_div, neg_neg] using
      (intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg f (a := a) (b := b))
  set C : ℝ := (Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sin (1 / Real.sqrt 2))⁻¹
  have hIntegrRect : IntegrableOn (Function.uncurry (fun α t => α * (extremalTest t * extremalTest (α - t))))
      (Set.uIoc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.uIoc a b) volume := by
    apply MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.of_bound _
      (measurable_fst.mul ((extremalTest_measurable.comp measurable_snd).mul
        (extremalTest_measurable.comp (measurable_fst.sub measurable_snd)))).aestronglyMeasurable (1 * (C * C))
    · filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem
        (measurableSet_uIoc.prod measurableSet_uIoc)] with p hp
      have hpα := hp.1
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hpα
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.sub_apply,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul
        (by rw [abs_of_pos hpα.1]; exact hpα.2 : |p.1| ≤ (1:ℝ))
        (mul_le_mul (extremalTest_abs_le _) (extremalTest_abs_le _) (abs_nonneg _)
          ((abs_nonneg (extremalTest 0)).trans (extremalTest_abs_le 0)))
        (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) zero_le_one
    · exact lt_of_le_of_lt
        (measure_mono (Set.prod_mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc))
        (isCompact_uIcc.prod isCompact_uIcc).measure_lt_top
  have hM : (∫ α in (0:ℝ)..1, α * extremalSelfConv α)
      = ∫ t in a..b, extremalTest t * ∫ v in a..b, max (t - v) 0 * extremalTest v := by
    refine Eq.trans ?_ ((MeasureTheory.intervalIntegral_intervalIntegral_swap hIntegrRect).trans ?_)
    · simp_rw [extremalSelfConv_eq_interval, ← ha, ← hb, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    · apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab, ha, hb, Set.mem_Icc] at ht
      simp_rw [mul_left_comm _ (extremalTest t), intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      rw [inner_reduce (by simpa only [abs_le, neg_div] using ht)]
      congr 1
      simpa only [extremalTest_even, sub_neg_eq_add, add_comm, ha, hb] using
        hneg (fun v => max (t - v) 0 * extremalTest v)
  have hrefl (t : ℝ) := (hneg (fun v => max (-t - v) 0 * extremalTest v)).symm
  simp only [extremalTest_even, sub_neg_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub] at hrefl
  rw [hM, two_mul]
  nth_rewrite 2 [← hneg (fun t => extremalTest t * ∫ v in a..b, max (t - v) 0 * extremalTest v)]
  simp only [extremalTest_even, hrefl]
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add
    (outer_intervalIntegrable (fun t v => max (t - v) 0)
      ((continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd).max continuous_const))
    (outer_intervalIntegrable (fun t v => max (v - t) 0)
      ((continuous_snd.sub continuous_fst).max continuous_const))]
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro t _
  simp only
  rw [← mul_add, ← intervalIntegral.integral_add
    (maxSubTest_intervalIntegrable t a b) (by
      simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using maxTest_intervalIntegrable (-t) a b)]
  simp_rw [← add_mul, ← max_zero_add_max_neg_zero_eq_abs_self, neg_sub]

name: LocalComplexGeometry.holomorphic_constant_rank
proof:
theorem holomorphic_constant_rank
    {n m r : ℕ}
    {F : ComplexEuclidean n → ComplexEuclidean m}
    {a : ComplexEuclidean n}
    (hF : AnalyticAt ℂ F a)
    (hrn : r ≤ n)
    (hrm : r ≤ m)
    (hconst : ∀ᶠ x in nhds a, complexRank (fderiv ℂ F x) = r) :
    ∃ (phi : LocalBiholomorphAt
          (ComplexEuclidean n) (ComplexEuclidean n) a 0)
      (psi : LocalBiholomorphAt
          (ComplexEuclidean m) (ComplexEuclidean m) (F a) 0),
      (fun x ↦ psi.toFun (F (phi.invFun x))) =ᶠ[nhds 0]
        standardRankMap n m r := by
  obtain ⟨n', hn⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hrn
  obtain ⟨m', hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hrm
  subst n
  subst m
  let A := fderiv ℂ F a
  let R := LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap
  have hRankR : Module.finrank ℂ R = r := hconst.self_of_nhds
  obtain ⟨Q, hRQ⟩ := Submodule.exists_isCompl R
  have hRQtop : Submodule.IsTopCompl R Q :=
    Submodule.IsCompl.isTopCompl_of_isClosed_of_finiteDimensional hRQ
      R.closed_of_finiteDimensional
  let : CompleteSpace R := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ R
  let : CompleteSpace Q := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ Q
  let pR := R.projectionOntoL Q hRQtop
  let pQ := Q.projectionOntoL R hRQtop.symm
  let targetDecomp := (Submodule.prodEquivOfIsTopCompl R Q hRQtop).symm
  have targetDecomp_apply (y : ComplexEuclidean (r + m')) :
      targetDecomp y = (pR y, pQ y) := by
    simp [targetDecomp, pR, pQ]
  let g := fun x ↦ pR (F x - F a)
  let g' := pR.comp A
  have hg : AnalyticAt ℂ g a :=
    (pR.analyticAt _).comp (hF.sub analyticAt_const)
  have hgDeriv : HasFDerivAt g g' a :=
    pR.hasFDerivAt.comp a (hF.hasStrictFDerivAt.hasFDerivAt.sub_const (F a))
  have hgSurj : Function.Surjective g' :=
    rangeProjection_comp_surjective A Q hRQtop
  let K := LinearMap.ker g'.toLinearMap
  let : CompleteSpace K := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ K
  obtain ⟨L, hKL⟩ := Submodule.exists_isCompl K
  have hKLtop : Submodule.IsTopCompl K L :=
    Submodule.IsCompl.isTopCompl_of_isClosed_of_finiteDimensional hKL
      K.closed_of_finiteDimensional
  let kproj := K.projectionOntoL L hKLtop
  have hkerCompl : IsCompl (LinearMap.ker g'.toLinearMap)
      (LinearMap.ker kproj.toLinearMap) := by
    simpa [K, kproj] using hKL
  let eLin := LinearMap.equivProdOfSurjectiveOfIsCompl g'.toLinearMap kproj.toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hgSurj)
      (Submodule.range_projectionOntoL hKLtop) hkerCompl
  let eDeriv := eLin.toContinuousLinearEquiv
  let H := fun x ↦ (g x, kproj (x - a))
  have hHAnalytic : AnalyticAt ℂ H a :=
    hg.prod ((kproj.analyticAt _).comp (analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const))
  have hkDeriv : HasFDerivAt (fun x ↦ kproj (x - a)) kproj a := by
    simpa only [map_sub] using kproj.hasFDerivAt.sub_const (kproj a)
  have hHfderiv : fderiv ℂ H a = (eDeriv : _ →L[ℂ] _) :=
    (hgDeriv.prodMk hkDeriv).fderiv
  let chiRaw := LocalBiholomorphAt.ofAnalyticAtOfFDerivEquiv
    hHAnalytic eDeriv hHfderiv
  have hHcenter : H a = (0, 0) := by simp only [H, g, sub_self, map_zero]
  let chi : LocalBiholomorphAt
      (ComplexEuclidean (r + n')) (R × K) a (0, 0) :=
    { toFun := H
      invFun := chiRaw.invFun
      map_source := hHcenter
      map_target := hHcenter ▸ chiRaw.map_target
      analyticAt_toFun := hHAnalytic
      analyticAt_invFun := hHcenter ▸ chiRaw.analyticAt_invFun
      left_inv := chiRaw.left_inv
      right_inv := hHcenter ▸ chiRaw.right_inv }
  have hKrank : Module.finrank ℂ K = n' := by
    have hdim := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker g'.toLinearMap
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hgSurj, finrank_top,
      hRankR, Module.finrank_fin_fun] at hdim
    exact Nat.add_left_cancel hdim
  have hQrank : Module.finrank ℂ Q = m' := by
    have hdim := Submodule.finrank_add_eq_of_isCompl hRQ
    rw [hRankR, Module.finrank_fin_fun] at hdim
    exact Nat.add_left_cancel hdim
  let P : R × K → R × Q := fun z ↦ targetDecomp (F (chi.invFun z) - F a)
  have hPAnalytic : AnalyticAt ℂ P 0 := by
    have hinner : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z ↦ F (chi.invFun z) - F a) 0 :=
      (hF.comp_of_eq chi.analyticAt_invFun chi.map_target).sub analyticAt_const
    exact (targetDecomp.toContinuousLinearMap.analyticAt _).comp hinner
  have hPfst : (fun z ↦ (P z).1) =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun z ↦ z.1 := by
    filter_upwards [chi.right_inv] with z hz
    have hz' := congrArg Prod.fst hz
    change g (chi.invFun z) = z.1 at hz'
    simpa only [P, targetDecomp_apply, g] using hz'
  have hPrank : ∀ᶠ z in nhds 0,
      complexLinearRank (fderiv ℂ P z) = Module.finrank ℂ R :=
    (eventually_complexLinearRank_affineConjugate hF chi targetDecomp hconst P rfl).mono
      fun z hz ↦ hz.trans hRankR.symm
  have hPslice := eventually_snd_eq_slice_of_rank hPAnalytic hPfst hPrank
  let q₀ : R → Q := fun u ↦ (P (u, 0)).2
  have hq₀Analytic : AnalyticAt ℂ q₀ 0 := by
    exact analyticAt_snd.comp (hPAnalytic.comp_of_eq
      (analyticAt_id.prod analyticAt_const) (by simp))
  have hPzero : P (0, 0) = (0, 0) := by
    change targetDecomp (F (chi.invFun (0, 0)) - F a) = (0, 0)
    rw [chi.map_target, sub_self, map_zero]
    rfl
  let shear := LocalBiholomorphAt.fiberShearAtZero q₀ hq₀Analytic
    (congrArg Prod.snd hPzero)
  have hNormal : (fun z ↦ shear.toFun (P z)) =ᶠ[nhds 0]
      fun z : R × K ↦ (z.1, (0 : Q)) := by
    filter_upwards [hPfst, hPslice] with z hfirst hsecond
    exact Prod.ext hfirst (sub_eq_zero.mpr
      (hsecond.trans (congrArg q₀ hfirst).symm))
  let eR : R ≃L[ℂ] ComplexEuclidean r :=
    ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq <| by
      simpa only [Module.finrank_fin_fun] using hRankR
  let eK : K ≃L[ℂ] ComplexEuclidean n' :=
    ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq <| by
      simpa only [Module.finrank_fin_fun] using hKrank
  let eQ : Q ≃L[ℂ] ComplexEuclidean m' :=
    ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq <| by
      simpa only [Module.finrank_fin_fun] using hQrank
  let eSource := (eR.prodCongr eK).trans (finProdContinuousLinearEquiv r n')
  let eTarget := (eR.prodCongr eQ).trans (finProdContinuousLinearEquiv r m')
  let sourceCoord := LocalBiholomorphAt.ofContinuousLinearEquivAtZero eSource
  let targetCoord := LocalBiholomorphAt.ofContinuousLinearEquivAtZero eTarget
  let centeredTarget := LocalBiholomorphAt.affine targetDecomp (F a) 0
  let phi := chi.trans sourceCoord
  let psi := centeredTarget.trans (shear.trans targetCoord)
  refine ⟨phi, psi, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [sourceCoord.invFun_tendsto hNormal] with x hx
  change shear.toFun (P (eSource.symm x)) = ((eSource.symm x).1, (0 : Q)) at hx
  calc
    psi.toFun (F (phi.invFun x)) = eTarget (shear.toFun (P (eSource.symm x))) :=
      congrArg (fun z ↦ eTarget (shear.toFun z)) (add_zero _)
    _ = eTarget ((eSource.symm x).1, (0 : Q)) := congrArg eTarget hx
    _ = standardRankMap (r + n') (r + m') r x :=
      productEquiv_fst_zero_eq_standardRankMap r n' m' eR eK eQ x

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PartialTriangulation.exists_chartMatchingControlOn_of_metricSpace
proof:
theorem exists_chartMatchingControlOn_of_metricSpace
    {S' : Type*} [MetricSpace S']
    (T : PartialTriangulation S') (c : MoiseChart S')
    (U : Set T.toIntrinsic.realization) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hsub : U ⊆ T.chartOverlap c) :
    ∃ mu : U → ℝ,
      StronglyPositiveOn Set.univ mu ∧
      ∀ (g' : U → c.kind.modelRegion)
        (g : T.toIntrinsic.realization → S'),
        (∀ y : U, g y.1 = (c.chart.symm (g' y)).1) →
        (∀ y : U,
          dist (g' y : Plane)
            (T.chartOverlapMap c ⟨y.1, hsub y.2⟩) ≤ mu y) →
        MatchesAtFrontier U g T.embed ∧
          Disjoint (g '' U) (T.embed '' Uᶜ) := by
  classical
  let model : U → c.kind.modelRegion := fun y ↦
    T.chartOverlapModelMap c ⟨y.1, hsub y.2⟩
  by_cases hComp : Uᶜ.Nonempty
  swap
  · refine ⟨fun _ ↦ 1, fun C _ _ ↦ ⟨1, one_pos, fun _ _ ↦ le_rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro g' g _ _
    exact matchesAtFrontier_and_disjoint_of_compl_not_nonempty T U hU hComp g
  let s : U → ℝ := fun y ↦ Metric.infDist (T.embed y.1) (T.embed '' Uᶜ)
  have hs (y : U) : 0 < s y := by
    apply ((hU.isClosed_compl.isCompact.image T.isEmbedding.continuous).isClosed.notMem_iff_infDist_pos (hComp.image _)).mp
    rintro ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
    exact hx (T.isEmbedding.injective heq ▸ y.2)
  let psi : c.kind.modelRegion → S' := fun z ↦ (c.chart.symm z).1
  have hmodelEq (y : U) : psi (model y) = T.embed y.1 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (c.chart.symm_apply_apply _)
  let A : U → Set ℝ := fun y ↦ {r | r ≤ 1 ∧
    ∀ z : c.kind.modelRegion, dist (z : Plane) (model y : Plane) < r →
      dist (psi z) (T.embed y.1) < s y}
  have hAbdd (y) : BddAbove (A y) := ⟨1, fun r hr ↦ hr.1⟩
  have hUniform : ∀ C : Set U, IsCompact C →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y ∈ C, δ ∈ A y := by
    intro C hC
    rcases C.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hCne
    · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun x hx ↦ hx.elim⟩
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, hmin⟩ := hC.exists_isMinOn hCne
      (((Metric.continuous_infDist_pt _).comp
        (T.isEmbedding.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val)).continuousOn)
    have hu := (hC.image (f := model) ((T.isEmbedding_chartOverlapModelMap c).continuous.comp
      (Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val _))).uniformContinuousAt_of_continuousAt psi
      (fun _ _ ↦ (continuous_subtype_val.comp c.chart.symm.continuous).continuousAt)
      (Metric.dist_mem_uniformity (hs y₀))
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hclose⟩ := Metric.mem_uniformity_dist.mp hu
    refine ⟨min δ 1, lt_min hδ one_pos, fun y hy ↦ ⟨min_le_right _ _, ?_⟩⟩
    intro z hz
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le _ (hmin hy)
    rw [← hmodelEq y, dist_comm]
    exact hclose (by
      rw [dist_comm, Subtype.dist_eq]
      exact hz.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)) ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨fun y ↦ sSup (A y) / 2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro C hC _
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hm⟩ := hUniform C hC
    exact ⟨δ / 2, half_pos hδ, fun y hy ↦
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_csSup (hAbdd y) (hm y hy)) zero_le_two⟩
  · intro g' g hg hclose
    have close (y : U) : dist (g y.1) (T.embed y.1) < s y := by
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hm⟩ := hUniform {y} isCompact_singleton
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hlt⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_csSup ⟨δ, hm y rfl⟩
        (half_lt_self (hδ.trans_le (le_csSup (hAbdd y) (hm y rfl))))
      rw [hg y]
      exact hr.2 (g' y) ((hclose y).trans_lt hlt)
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      have hb := (T.isEmbedding.continuous.tendsto x).mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := U))
      apply hb.congr_dist
      apply squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ ↦ dist_nonneg) ?_
        (tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mp hb)
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hy
      rw [dist_comm]
      exact (close ⟨y, hy⟩).le.trans (Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem
        ⟨x, by simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, hU.interior_eq] using hx.2, rfl⟩)
    · rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      rintro z ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ ⟨y, hy, heq⟩
      have hi := (close ⟨x, hx⟩).trans_le
        (Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩)
      rw [heq, dist_comm] at hi
      exact lt_irrefl _ hi

name: LeanEval.Topology.ClassificationOfSurfaces.Moise.PolygonalCircle.insertZero_nonadjacent_disjoint
proof:
theorem insertZero_nonadjacent_disjoint (J : PolygonalCircle) {p : Plane}
    (hp : p ∈ J.edgeSegment 0) (hp0 : p ≠ J.vertex 0) (hp1 : p ≠ J.vertex 1)
    (i j : ZMod (J.n + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j) (hprev : i ≠ j + 1)
    (hnext : j ≠ i + 1) :
    J.insertZeroEdgeSegment p i ∩ J.insertZeroEdgeSegment p j = ∅ := by
  wlog hle : i.val ≤ j.val generalizing i j
  · rw [Set.inter_comm]
    exact this j i hij.symm hnext hprev (by omega)
  have hi := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val i
  have hj := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val j
  have hgap : i.val + 1 < j.val := by
    have hne : i.val ≠ j.val := fun h => hij (ZMod.val_injective _ h)
    have hsucc : j.val ≠ i.val + 1 := by
      intro h
      apply hnext
      rw [← hi, ← hj, h, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    omega
  have hzero : i.val = 0 → j.val < J.n := by
    intro hz
    have hne : j.val ≠ J.n := by
      intro hn
      apply hprev
      rw [← hi, ← hj, hz, hn, Nat.cast_zero]
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
        (ZMod.natCast_self (J.n + 1)).symm
    have := j.val_lt
    omega
  suffices ordered : ∀ (m l : ℕ), l < J.n + 1 → m + 1 < l →
      (m = 0 → l < J.n) →
      Disjoint (J.insertZeroEdgeSegment p (m : ZMod (J.n + 1)))
        (J.insertZeroEdgeSegment p (l : ZMod (J.n + 1))) by
    apply Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp
    simpa only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using
      ordered i.val j.val j.val_lt hgap hzero
  clear i j hij hprev hnext hle hi hj hgap hzero
  let : Fact (1 < J.n) := ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide) J.three_le⟩
  have hz (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 < k) (hkn : k + 1 < J.n) :
      Disjoint (J.edgeSegment 0) (J.edgeSegment (k : ZMod J.n)) := by
    have hklt : k < J.n := lt_trans (Nat.lt_succ_self k) hkn
    apply Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr
    apply J.nonadjacent_disjoint <;> intro h <;>
      have hv := congrArg ZMod.val h <;>
      simp only [zero_add, ZMod.val_add, ZMod.val_zero,
        ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hklt, ZMod.val_one,
        Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hkn] at hv <;> omega
  intro m l hl hgap hzero
  by_cases hm0 : m = 0
  · have hllt := hzero hm0
    rw [hm0, Nat.cast_zero, J.insertZeroEdgeSegment_zero,
      J.insertZeroEdgeSegment_middle p (by omega) hllt]
    by_cases hlast : l = J.n - 1
    · rw [hlast]
      exact J.disjoint_insertZero_first_previous hp hp0 hp1
    · exact (hz l (by omega) (by omega)).mono_left
        (J.insertZero_first_subset_edge_zero hp)
  · have hmpos : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm0
    have hmlt : m < J.n := by omega
    rw [J.insertZeroEdgeSegment_middle p hmpos hmlt]
    by_cases hln : l = J.n
    · rw [hln, J.insertZeroEdgeSegment_last]
      by_cases hm1 : m = 1
      · rw [hm1, Nat.cast_one]
        exact (J.disjoint_insertZero_last_next hp hp0 hp1).symm
      · exact ((hz m (by omega) (by omega)).mono_left
          (J.insertZero_last_subset_edge_zero hp)).symm
    · have hllt : l < J.n := by omega
      rw [J.insertZeroEdgeSegment_middle p (by omega) hllt]
      apply Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr
      apply J.nonadjacent_disjoint
      · intro h
        have := natCast_eq_natCast_of_lt hmlt hllt h
        omega
      · intro h
        have := natCast_eq_succ_of_pos_lt hmpos hmlt hllt h
        omega
      · intro h
        have := natCast_eq_succ_of_pos_lt (by omega : 0 < l) hllt hmlt h
        omega

name: IsoGraph.Canon.dfsNode_dom
proof:
theorem dfsNode_dom (n : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (path : Array Nat) (invPath : Array UInt64) (p : Part) (st : St)
      (D : List (List UInt64) → Prop),
      Node n f path invPath p → n + 1 ≤ numCells n p + fuel → st.abortTo = none →
      StGood n f st → Pth st path → Jmp n f (DomD D st) path st →
        Guar n f D path st (dfsNode (Graph.ofOracle n f) fuel path invPath p st) := by
  refine dfsNode.induct (Graph.ofOracle n f)
    (motive1 := _)
    (motive2 := fun fuel path invPath p verts processed orb st =>
      ∀ D : List (List UInt64) → Prop,
      Node n f path invPath p → (∃ c, p.targetCell n = some c) → (∀ v ∈ verts, Chld n p v) →
      verts.Nodup → n ≤ numCells n p + fuel → st.abortTo = none → StGood n f st →
      (∀ l, Rec st l → ∀ w ∈ verts, ¬ PathPre (path.push w) l.path) →
      JmpC n f (DomD D st) path st →
      (∀ w, Chld n p w → w ∉ verts → Dchild n f D invPath p st w) →
      (∀ w ∈ processed, Dchild n f D invPath p st w) →
      MarkP (Dchild n f D invPath p st) orb.mark →
      (∀ g ∈ orb.gens, IsAutoArr n f g ∧ ∀ i, i < path.size → g[path[i]!]! = path[i]!) →
        Guar n f D path st
          (dfsChildren (Graph.ofOracle n f) fuel path invPath p verts processed orb st))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  case refine_1 =>
    intro path invPath p st D hnode hfuel _ _ _ _
    exact False.elim (Nat.not_succ_le_self n (hfuel.trans (numCells_le (n := n) p)))
  case refine_2 =>
    intro path invPath p st fuel habort D _ _ hnone _ _ _
    rw [hnone] at habort; simp at habort
  case refine_3 =>
    intro path invPath p st fuel habort hprune D hnode _ hnone _ _ _
    rw [dfsNode_pruned (by simpa using habort) hprune]
    refine ⟨fun j hj => absurd (hnone.symm.trans hj) (by simp), fun k hk => ?_, BestMono.rfl st⟩
    rw [hnone] at hk; simp only [stopDepth] at hk
    exact Or.inl (pruneNode_none hprune ((ancReach_full hnode k).1 hk)).dom
  case' refine_4 =>
    intro path invPath p st fuel habort st1 hprune htc D hnode hfuel hnone hgood hpth hjmp
  case' refine_5 =>
    intro path invPath p st fuel habort st1 hprune st2 s htc verts orb ih D hnode hfuel hnone
      hgood hpth hjmp
  case' refine_4 | refine_5 =>
    have hmono := dfsNode_mono n f (fuel + 1) path invPath p st hnode.wf hfuel
  case' refine_4 =>
    rw [dfsNode_leaf (by simpa using habort) hprune htc] at hmono ⊢
    set st2 : St := { st1 with nodes := st1.nodes + 1 }
  case' refine_5 =>
    rw [dfsNode_branch (by simpa using habort) hprune htc] at hmono ⊢
  case' refine_4 | refine_5 =>
    have hrec2 : ∀ l, Rec st2 l → Rec st l := fun l hl => pruneNode_rec hprune hl

  case refine_4 =>
    have hjmp2 : Jmp n f (DomD D st) path st2 := fun l hl => hjmp l (hrec2 l hl)
    refine ⟨fun j hj => (leaf_abort_dom hnode hgood2 hpth2 hjmp2 hj).1, fun k hk => ?_, hmono⟩
    rcases hab : (leafUpdate (Graph.ofOracle n f) path invPath p.lab st2).abortTo with _ | j
    · rw [hab] at hk; simp only [stopDepth] at hk
      have hkk := reach_leaf_key htc ((ancReach_full hnode k).1 hk)
      exact Or.inl (hkk ▸ leafUpdate_dom_new (Graph.ofOracle n f) path invPath p.lab st2)
    · obtain ⟨hjlt, hdk⟩ := leaf_abort_dom hnode hgood2 hpth2 hjmp2 hab
      simp only [hab, stopDepth, Nat.min_eq_left hjlt] at hk
      exact (hdk k hk).up hmono
  case refine_5 =>
    have hp : Part.WF n p := hnode.wf
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (DomD D st) hnode ⟨s, htc⟩
      (fun w hw => ⟨s, htc, mem_extract_lt hp hw,
        mem_extract_cell hp (targetCell_lt n p s htc) (targetCell_cst hp htc) hw⟩)
      (extract_nodup hp s p.cen[s]!) (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hfuel)
      (by rw [pruneNode_abortTo hprune]; exact hnone) hgood2
      (fun l hl w _ hw => hpth2 l hl hw.of_push)
      (JmpC.of_jmp (fun l hl j hj1 hj2 ht hne k hk =>
        (hjmp l (hrec2 l hl) j hj1 hj2 ht hne k hk).of) hpth2)
      (by
        intro w hw hnw; obtain ⟨c, hc, hwn, hcell⟩ := hw
        rw [(Option.some.inj (htc.symm.trans hc)).symm] at hcell
        exact absurd (mem_extract_cell' hp (targetCell_lt n p s htc) (targetCell_cst hp htc)

      (by simp) markP_replicate
      (by
        intro g hg; obtain ⟨hg1, hg2⟩ := mem_usableAutos hg
        exact ⟨hgood2.2.2 g hg1, hg2⟩)
    exact ⟨h1, fun k hk => (h2 k hk).shift hmono, hmono⟩
  case refine_6 =>
    intro fuel path invPath p processed orb st D hnode htcex _ _ _ hnone _ _ _ hloop _ _ _
    obtain ⟨c, htc⟩ := htcex; rw [dfsChildren_nil]
    refine ⟨fun j hj => absurd (hnone.symm.trans hj) (by simp), fun k hk => ?_, BestMono.rfl st⟩
    rw [hnone] at hk; simp only [stopDepth] at hk
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hsub⟩ := (reach_iff_subR htc k).1 ((ancReach_full hnode k).1 hk)
    exact (hloop w hw (by simp)).2 k hsub
  case refine_7 =>
    intro fuel path invPath p processed orb st v vs habort D _ _ _ _ _ hnone _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    rw [hnone] at habort; simp at habort
  case' refine_8 =>
    intro fuel path invPath p processed orb st v vs habort orb1 hmark ih D hnode htcex hverts
      hnodup hfuel hnone hgood hpthc hjmpc hloop hproc hmarkP hgens
  case' refine_9 =>
    intro fuel path invPath p processed orb st v vs habort orb1 hmark p' s hind inW p'' tr href
      childInv' st1 st2 habort2 ih1 D hnode htcex hverts hnodup hfuel hnone hgood hpthc hjmpc
      hloop hproc hmarkP hgens
  case' refine_10 =>
    intro fuel path invPath p processed orb st v vs habort orb1 hmark p' s hind inW p'' tr href
      childInv' st1 st2 habort2 orb2 ih1 _ih1' ih2 D hnode htcex hverts hnodup hfuel hnone
      hgood hpthc hjmpc hloop hproc hmarkP hgens
  case' refine_8 | refine_10 =>
    have hgens1 := orbRefresh_gens (processed := processed) hgens hgood
    have hmarkP1 : MarkP (Dchild n f D invPath p st) orb1.mark :=
      orbRefresh_markP (fun g hg w hw =>
        dchild_gen hnode (hgood.2.2 g (mem_usableAutos hg).1) (mem_usableAutos hg).2 w hw)
        hproc hmarkP
  case refine_8 =>
    rw [dfsChildren_marked (by simpa using habort) hmark]
    refine ih D hnode htcex (fun w hw => hverts w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw)) hnodup.of_cons
      hfuel hnone hgood (fun l hl w hw => hpthc l hl w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw)) hjmpc
      ?_ hproc hmarkP1 hgens1
    intro w hw hnw; by_cases hwv : w = v
    · subst hwv; exact hmarkP1 w hmark
    · exact hloop w hw (by simp [hwv, hnw])
  all_goals
    obtain ⟨c, htc, hv, hcell⟩ := hverts v (by simp)
    have hchild : child (Graph.ofOracle n f) p v = (p'', tr) := by rw [child, hind]; exact href
    have hcinv : childInv (Graph.ofOracle n f) invPath p v = childInv' := by rw [childInv, hchild]
    have hnode' : Node n f (path.push v) childInv' p'' := by
      simpa only [hchild, hcinv] using Node.step hnode htc hv hcell
    have hnc : numCells n p < numCells n p'' := by
      simpa only [hchild] using numCells_child (n := n) (f := f) hnode.wf htc hv hcell
    have hg1 := ih1 D hnode'
      (Nat.le_trans (Nat.succ_le_succ hfuel) (by
        simpa only [Nat.succ_add] using Nat.add_le_add_right hnc fuel)) hnone hgood
      (fun l hl => hpthc l hl v (by simp)) (hjmpc.child v)
  case refine_9 =>
    rw [dfsChildren_step_stop (by simpa using habort)
      (by simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hmark; exact hmark) hind href habort2]
    exact guar_stop hg1 habort2
  case refine_10 =>
    rw [dfsChildren_step_go (by simpa using habort)
      (by simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hmark; exact hmark) hind href
      (by simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at habort2; exact habort2)]
    obtain ⟨hdv, hab2, hm2⟩ := guar_go hnode hv hg1
      (by simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at habort2; exact habort2)
    let ST2 := unwind path (dfsNode (Graph.ofOracle n f) fuel (path.push v) childInv' p'' st)
    have hvne : ∀ w ∈ vs, ¬ w = v := fun w hw he => (List.nodup_cons.1 hnodup).1 (he ▸ hw)
    have hgood2 :=
      (dfsNode_good n f fuel (path.push v) childInv' p'' st hnode' hgood).unwind path
    have hrec2 := rec_iff_stq.1 ((dfsNode_paths n f
        (fun Q => PathPre (path.push v) Q ∨ ∃ z, Rec st z ∧ z.path = Q)
        fuel (path.push v) childInv' p'' st (fun Q hQ => Or.inl hQ)
        (rec_iff_stq.2 (fun z hz => Or.inr ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩))).unwind path)
    have hF : MarkP (Dchild n f (DomD D ST2) invPath p ST2) orb2.mark := by
      refine closureLoop_P (fun g hg w hw =>
          dchild_gen hnode (hgens1 g hg).1 (hgens1 g hg).2 w hw) _ _ _
        (markP_set (fun w hw => ((hmarkP1 w hw).up hm2).self_of) hdv.self_of) (fun i hi => ?_)
      obtain rfl : i = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hi)
      simpa using hdv.self_of
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih2 (DomD D ST2) hnode htcex
      (fun w hw => hverts w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw)) hnodup.of_cons hfuel hab2 hgood2
      (by
        intro l hl w hw hpre; rcases hrec2 l hl with hp1 | ⟨z, hz, hzp⟩
        · exact hvne w hw ((PathPre.push_iff.1 hpre).2.2.symm.trans (PathPre.push_iff.1 hp1).2.2)
        · exact hpthc z hz w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw) (by rw [hzp]; exact hpre))
      (by
        intro l hl j hjle hjl htake hne k hk; rcases hrec2 l hl with hp1 | ⟨z, hz, hzp⟩
        · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j path.size with hlt | hge
          · exact absurd ((PathPre.push_iff.1 hp1).1.2 j hlt) (hne hlt)
          · obtain rfl : j = path.size := Nat.le_antisymm hjle hge
            have hcong : (path.push v).toList.take (path.size + 1)

            exact Or.inr (hdv.2 k ((ancReach_child hnode v k).1 ((ancReach_congr hcong k).2 hk)))
        · have hzjmp := hjmpc z hz
          rw [hzp] at hzjmp
          exact Or.inr ((hzjmp j hjle hjl htake hne k hk).up hm2))
      (by
        intro w hw hnw; by_cases hwv : w = v
        · subst hwv; exact hdv.self_of
        · exact ((hloop w hw (by simp [hwv, hnw])).up hm2).self_of)
      (by
        intro w hw; rcases Array.mem_push.1 hw with hw1 | rfl
        · exact ((hproc w hw1).up hm2).self_of
        · exact hdv.self_of)
      hF hgens1
    exact ⟨h1, fun k hk => (h2 k hk).shift h3, hm2.trans h3⟩

name: FirstOrder.Language.schemaTruthStage_imp
proof:
private theorem schemaTruthStage_imp
    (hM : Cardinal.beth (Ordinal.omega 1) ≤ Cardinal.mk M) (k : ℕ) {n : ℕ}
    (φ ψ' : (Llocal s₀ (k + 1)).BoundedFormulaω Empty n)
    (ihφ : SchemaTruthStage hM k φ) (ihψ : SchemaTruthStage hM k ψ') :
    SchemaTruthStage hM k (φ.imp ψ') := by
  classical
  let : (localColim s₀).Structure M := localColimStructure s₀
  intro hmem ts
  have hφ := bfSubformulas_subset_Γlocal_succ s₀ hmem (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hψ := bfSubformulas_subset_Γlocal_succ s₀ hmem (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  simp only [BoundedFormulaω.mapLanguage, BoundedFormulaω.realize_imp, ihφ hφ ts, ihψ hψ ts]
  let S χ := schemaFormulaSentence
    (BoundedFormulaω.mapLanguage (LlocalInclusion s₀ (k + 1)) χ) ts
  let T := schemaCompletionTheory (schemaEnumeration s₀) hM
  let sign χ := if S χ ∈ T then S χ else (S χ).not
  have hs χ (hm : ⟨n, χ⟩ ∈ Γlocal s₀ (k + 1)) : sign χ ∈ T := by
    dsimp only [sign]
    split
    · assumption
    · exact (schemaCompletionTheory_not_mem_iff hM _
        (schemaFormulaSentence_mem_universe (toLocalColimFormula_mem_ΓlocalColim s₀ hm) ts)).2 ‹_›
  let F : Finset _ := {sign φ, sign ψ', sign (φ.imp ψ')}
  obtain ⟨σ, w, hb⟩ := exists_body_of_subset hM F (by
    simp [F]
    exact ⟨hs _ hφ, hs _ hψ, hs _ hmem⟩)
  have hv χ (hh : sign χ ∈ F) :
      realizeWith σ w (S χ) Empty.elim Fin.elim0 ↔ S χ ∈ T := by
    by_cases ht : S χ ∈ T <;>
      simpa [sign, ht, realizeWith_not] using hb _ hh
  simp only [S, realize_schemaFormulaSentence_iff] at hv
  simpa only [BoundedFormulaω.mapLanguage, BoundedFormulaω.realize_imp,
    hv φ (by simp [F]), hv ψ' (by simp [F])] using hv (φ.imp ψ') (by simp [F])

name: RS.cechCount
proof:
theorem cechCount : Module.finrank ℂ (RS.Cech.H1 (0 : RS.Divisor X)) ≤ genus X := by
  classical
  change RS.Finiteness.h1 (0 : RS.Divisor X) ≤ _
  by_contra
  let P := Classical.arbitrary X
  let n : ℤ := 2 * RS.Finiteness.h1 (0 : RS.Divisor X)
  let D : RS.Divisor X := Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single P n
  let E : RS.Divisor X := Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single P (2 * n)
  have : (RS.Finiteness.h1 D : ℤ) = _ := h1_single_eq P (by omega)
  have : (RS.Finiteness.h1 E : ℤ) = _ := h1_single_eq P (by omega)
  have : (RS.l D : ℤ) = _ := l_single_eq P (by omega)
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ⟩ := Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mp
    (by omega : 0 < RS.Finiteness.h1 D)
  have hb (q : RS.LinSys D) : RS.Cech.MulBound q D E :=
    RS.Cech.mulBound_of_mem_linSys q.2 (fun x => by
      simp only [D, E, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply]
      split_ifs <;> omega)
  let Φ : RS.LinSys D →ₗ[ℂ] RS.Cech.H1 E :=
    { toFun q := RS.Cech.mulH1 (q : ℳ X) (hb q) ξ
      map_add' _ _ := RS.Cech.mulH1_add _ _ _ _
      map_smul' _ _ := RS.Cech.mulH1_smul _ _ _ _ }
  have : RS.l D ≤ RS.Finiteness.h1 E :=
    LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective ((injective_iff_map_eq_zero Φ).mpr (by
      intro q hq
      by_contra hq0
      exact hξ ((map_eq_zero_iff _ ((LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank
        (by omega : RS.Finiteness.h1 D = RS.Finiteness.h1 E)).mpr
        (RS.Cech.mulH1_surjective (fun h => hq0 (Subtype.ext h)) (hb q)))).mp hq)))
  omega
